newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan blanks out pornography at ADB.
newsitem.headline: Japan blanks out pornography at ADB.

text.p: Japan has ensured that delegates attending the Asian Development Bank's annual meeting here have only good clean fun.
The main hotel where most of the 3,000 delegates are staying for the meeting of finance ministers and central bank governors has blanked out two pay channels which usually show pornographic movies.
Hotel staff said they took the action on the advice of Japanese officials who organised the gathering.
"They said the films were not appropriate for a distinguished gathering like the ADB," one staff member said.
